newsitem.title: USA: American Eagle sells aviation unit to AFG.
newsitem.headline: American Eagle sells aviation unit to AFG.

text.p: American Eagle Insurance Co, a unit of American Eagle Group Inc, said on Friday that it sold its general aviation insurance business to American Financial Group Inc.

American Eagle said it sold the unit to AFG in exchange for thirty percent of the estimated $30 million of unearned premiums to be transferred to AFG as well as the the book value of all furniture, fixtures and equipment to be transferred to AFG.

Other terms include American Eagle's collection of commissions of four percent, two percent and one percent of the premiums on renewal policies relating to the unit during the first, second and third years, respectively, following the closing of the transaction.
Also, AFG has agreed to transfer to American Eagle shares of American Eagle's Series D Preferred Stock issued by American Eagle to AFG in December 1996.

As a result of the transaction, AFG's ownership in American Eagle will be reduced from 6,932,667 shares of the outstanding common stock to 116,000 shares, American Eagle said. Sunday, 13 April 1997 18:39:25
